praying for the dead is a spiritual work of mercy as well as an act of love offered for them. it acknowledges our belief in purgatory, a state of final purification for those who die in god's grace but are not yet perfectly cleansed. our presence and our prayers, especially at mass, assist souls on this journey towards the ultimate christian vision of seeing god face to face where there is complete happiness and lasting peace. prayer eternal rest grant to them, o lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them. may their souls and the souls of all the faithful departed, through the mercy of god, rest in peace. amen. church services marino:

removed_lines: church of st. vincent de paul marino thought for the day when the pharisees hand jesus a roman coin, they are trying to trap him.
but jesus uses that tiny piece of metal to reveal a massive spiritual truth.
he asks them, "whose image is this, and whose inscription?
the coin bore the face of tiberius caesar and an inscription calling him the son of a god.
because caesar’s image was stamped onto the metal, the coin belonged to caesar's earthly realm.
but jesus immediately pivots to a much bigger question: what bears the image and inscription of god?
you do, because his image is stamped on your heart and soul.

prayer: lord jesus, you hold up the coin of caesar to remind me of a greater truth: that i am stamped with the image and likeness of god . forgive me for the times i give my heart, my peace, and my ultimate devotion to the passing things of this world.
help me to fulfil my daily duties with honesty, but never to lose sight of who i truly belong to.
